# sdlc-tools

Tool definitions that serve only software delivery, one folder per Tool (`tools/<id>/<id>.json`, as in cat-harness's own `tools/`): the CI workflow dispatchers (`ci-*`), the merge train and its helpers (`merge-train`, `merge-overlap`, `merge-leftover`, `gates-merged`, `judge-tree`) and `release-please`. Each satisfies only `sdlc` skills, so off, it named skills a downstream does not have. Moved out of `tools/` for owner card Q-OPTIN-REFS A (2026-11-12).

Part of [C@T Harness](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `sdlc-tools`, holding `tools`.
